events.title: Kublai Khan Proclaims the Yuan Dynasty
events.description: Kublai Khan officially renamed his empire "Yuan". This marked the formal start of the Yuan dynasty in China and Mongolia.
events.significance: The Yuan dynasty made Mongol rule of China official. Kublai Khan's court became one of the most powerful and cosmopolitan in the world.

events.title: America Celebrates Its First Thanksgiving
events.description: The United States marked a national day of thanksgiving to celebrate the American victory over British General John Burgoyne at Saratoga that October.
events.significance: It was an early national thanksgiving observance in the young republic. The holiday later developed into the November Thanksgiving Americans celebrate today.

events.title: The Thirteenth Amendment Is Declared Adopted
events.description: Secretary of State William Seward proclaimed that the Thirteenth Amendment had been ratified. It prohibited slavery throughout the United States.
events.significance: The amendment formally ended legal slavery in the United States. It was a turning point in American history after the Civil War.

events.title: Project SCORE Launches the First Communications Satellite
events.description: The United States launched Project SCORE, the first satellite built to relay communications. It carried a recorded holiday message from the U.S. president.
events.significance: It showed that satellites could relay voice messages across great distances. That paved the way for global satellite communications.
